        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures')
    );

        email                   NVARCHAR(150) NULL,

        phone                   NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        jobTitle                NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        message                 NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        leadSource              NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        interestArea            NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        status                  NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        assignedTo              INT NULL,
        privacyConsentAccepted  BIT NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO @payload (
        leadCaptureId,
        fullName,
        email,
        companyName,
        phone,
        jobTitle,
        message,
        leadSource,
        interestArea,
        status,
        assignedTo,
        privacyConsentAccepted
    )
    SELECT
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadCaptureId')),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.fullName'),
        LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(JSON_VALUE(value, '$.email')))), -- Normalize email
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyName'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.phone'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.jobTitle'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.message'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadSource'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.interestArea'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.status'),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.assignedTo')),
        TRY_CONVERT(BIT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.privacyConsentAccepted'))
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures');

    IF @action = 1 -- INSERT
    BEGIN
        -- Check for duplicates within the payload based on normalized email
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload
            WHERE email IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY email
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate normalized email entries within the payload.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for conflicts against existing table based on normalized email
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.email = p.email
            WHERE p.email IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Lead with this email already exists.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        INSERT INTO dbo.leadCaptures (
            fullName,
            email,
            companyName,
            phone,
            jobTitle,
            message,
            leadSource,
            interestArea,
            status,
            assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted,
            created_At
        )
        SELECT
            p.fullName,
            p.email,
            p.companyName,
            p.phone,
            p.jobTitle,
            p.message,
            p.leadSource,
            p.interestArea,
            ISNULL(p.status, 'New'), -- Default status to 'New' if not provided
            p.assignedTo,
            ISNULL(p.privacyConsentAccepted, 0), -- Default privacyConsentAccepted to 0 if not provided
            GETDATE()
        FROM @payload p;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 2 -- UPDATE
    BEGIN
        -- Check for duplicates within the payload, excluding the record being updated itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload p
            WHERE p.email IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY p.email
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate normalized email entries within the payload.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for conflicts against existing table, excluding the record being updated itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.email = p.email
            WHERE lc.leadCaptureId <> p.leadCaptureId
              AND p.email IS NOT NULL
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Lead with this email already exists.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        UPDATE lc
        SET
            fullName                = p.fullName,
            email                   = p.email,
            companyName             = p.companyName,
            phone                   = p.phone,
            jobTitle                = p.jobTitle,
            message                 = p.message,
            leadSource              = p.leadSource,
            interestArea            = p.interestArea,
            status                  = p.status,
            assignedTo              = p.assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted  = p.privacyConsentAccepted,
            updated_at              = GETDATE()
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 3 -- DELETE
    BEGIN
        DELETE lc
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId;
    END

    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Inserted/Updated/Deleted Successfully');
